news.title: This bitcoin bear market is different with 'uniquely pessimistic' traders limiting downside, K33 says
news.summary: The research firm said bitcoin traders remain unusually defensive, reducing the risk of the kind of leverage-driven collapse seen in prior downturns.

news.title: Trump orders government, Fed to review crypto firms' access to payment rails
news.summary: Donald Trump's executive order asks the Fed to review how depository institutions may be granted access to payment services, an area the crypto industry is deeply involved with.

news.title: Bitcoin is falling, bond yields are rising. Yet BTC’s implied volatility, an uncertainty gauge, remains low.
news.summary: BTC's implied volatility remains low despite the recent price selloff. Options specialist prefers a long straddle strategy in this scenario.
